source: Natural Earth (public domain) — admin_0 110m, geography_regions 10m, admin_1 10m, admin_0 10m
orderNote: draw order, largest first — a contained region must be drawn after its container to stay hoverable
continentSource: Old World: WGSRPD level 1, folded to Africa / Asia / Oceania, with one deliberate departure: PAPUASIA IS OCEANIA HERE (8.18.26), not the Asia-Tropical WGSRPD files it under. The rule is ON THE ISLAND OF NEW GUINEA -> OCEANIA: New Guinea itself, Papua New Guinea and its provinces, the Indonesian provinces Papua and West Papua (pre-2022 extents — Natural Earth has no geometry for the six-province split), plus the Bismarck Archipelago and the Solomon Islands. MALUKU and NORTH MALUKU are the exception and stay ASIA: island groups west of New Guinea, kept with Indonesia. New World: colloquial, NOT WGSRPD — North America / Central America / Caribbean / South America, matching the site's habit of colloquial continent tags. Strict WGSRPD would file Costa Rica and Cuba under Southern America. Assignment is an explicit table in the builder; an unlisted place aborts the build.
frameNote: viewBox is fitted to the places the archive actually covers; places marked "frame": false in places.json are drawn but excluded from it. viewBoxAll is the extent of every shape in the file.
hdNote: HIGH-DETAIL build for the genus range map: tolerances at 0.25x the journal shapes.json, country geometry from admin_0 10m, plus a `borders` country-hairline path. The journal map must keep using shapes.json.
parentNote: piece -> country, for the WGSRPD-split countries. Derived 8.19.26 from Natural Earth admin_1's `admin` field by majority vote across each alias union; unanimity fails on Cordoba (Colombia) and Santa Cruz (Bolivia). The card draws the parent and skips an UNLIT piece that has one. Lit pieces and the context wash are unaffected.
